title: Wicket W. Warrick
subtitle: Rebel Alliance
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: As a young Ewok warrior from the Bright Tree village, Wicket W. Warrick was the first to find Princess Leia Organa in the nearby forest. That simple act helped unite the Rebel Alliance and the Ewoks in their common fight against the evil Galactic Empire. Brave and cunning, Wicket fought valiantly against the Stormtroopers during the Battle of Endor alongside his tribe.
